content.title: Parker Hannifin 401-2850 Butterfly Valve, 2-Way, Cv 900, Max 120°C
content.short_description: Parker Hannifin 401-2850 is a 2-way butterfly valve with a flow coefficient (Cv) of 900, rated for service up to 120°C.
content.long_description:
The Parker Hannifin 401-2850 is a 2-way butterfly valve intended for fluid handling applications requiring a high flow coefficient. With a Cv rating of 900, the valve supports high-flow-rate service in industrial piping systems where minimal pressure drop across the valve is a design requirement.

The valve is configured as a 2-way unit, allowing straightforward on/off or throttling control within a single flow path. It is rated for a maximum operating temperature of 120°C, making it suitable for process lines operating within this thermal limit.

As a butterfly-style valve, the 401-2850 uses a rotating disc mechanism for flow control, a design typically selected for applications where compact footprint and quick quarter-turn actuation are priorities compared to other valve types. Confirm system pressure, media compatibility, and connection type against your process specifications before installation, as these details are not included in the verified attributes above.
